subject: Re: Private Offer for Premium Bundle - channel split & SKU bundling
messages:
From: Kyle Johnson <k.johnson@acme-analytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private offer & bundled SKUs for premium plan

Diego —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement lead asked whether we can get a private offer for the Premium bundle (compute + inference credits + support) via AWS Marketplace. Two specific asks from Acme: (1) a single bundled SKU at a ~25% list discount vs published marketplace pricing, and (2) clarity on how the channel/reseller split would be handled if we accept ResellCo as our channel partner.

Key constraints: 12-month commit, start-of-quarter activation, credit usage rollover allowed. We need a carrier/reseller margin model to include in our internal procurement packet. Can you (a) confirm whether Redwood can issue an AWS private offer with a bundled SKU, and (b) provide an example channel margin/commission waterfall we typically use for ResellCo-type partners?

If possible please send a draft private offer and a simple spreadsheet with discount math we can present to procurement.

—Kyle
Kyle Johnson
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Analytics

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Johnson <k.johnson@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 08:31:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & bundled SKUs for premium plan

Kyle —

Thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front: (a) yes, we can create a single bundled SKU for AWS Private Offer and (b) we can support a reseller split model with ResellCo. I attached a draft private offer PDF and a pricing-sheet that lays out the math.

High-level proposal for Acme (proposal for internal review):
- Product: Premium Bundle (Monthly compute + Inference credits + Business Support) as 1 AWS SKU.
- List price (marketplace): $X per unit/month — we will offer a 25% off list for an annual 12-month commitment.
- Channel split: 60% Redwood rev / 25% ResellCo commission / 15% reserved for marketplace fees & taxes. This translates to a ~25% commission at list-level but nets differently once we apply the customer discount; see attached sheet.
- Conditional concession: if Acme commits to >$600k ARR and shares a forecast, Redwood can increase channel pool to allow ResellCo a 30% commission while Redwood keeps parity on net revenue.

Open items for procurement
- Which billing contact will sign the PO in AWS Market (Acme or ResellCo)?
- Do you require an MSA redline before we issue the PO?

Next steps: If that looks directionally right, I’ll loop Monica (our partner ops) to confirm ResellCo onboarding requirements and Karthik to prepare a final private offer for the AWS console.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer & bundled SKUs for premium plan

Diego / Karthik —

Quick notes from pricing: the 60/25/15 waterfall is fine as a starting point but we need to be explicit about which items are considered "list" for commission calc. For AWS private offers we treat the "Customer Price" (the discounted price) as the base for partner commission unless partner contract specifies otherwise.

Action items for Karthik:
- Produce two variants in the sheet: (A) partner commission applied to list price; (B) partner commission applied to customer discounted price. Include net Redwood ARR impact for both.
- Mark the SKU as "bundle-premium-v1" in the private offer draft so operations can find it.

Monica: please confirm partner onboarding docs we need from ResellCo (tax forms, seller ID) and whether ResellCo is a registered marketplace reseller already.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & bundled SKUs for premium plan

Marissa / team —

Attached updated pricing-sheet_AWS_SKU_bundle.xlsx (tabbed: scenario-list-commission, scenario-discounted-commission). Summary numbers:
- Scenario A (commission on list): Redwood net ARR = $450k; ResellCo = $150k; marketplace fees/taxes = $100k (assumes 15% marketplace/taxes bucket).
- Scenario B (commission on discounted customer price): Redwood net ARR = $480k; ResellCo = $120k; marketplace fees/taxes = $100k.

Recommendation: present Scenario B to Acme — it preserves higher net for Redwood while still giving ResellCo a healthy commission. Offer a one-time onboarding credit of $12k for ResellCo if they commit to joint sales activities and a 12-month minimum commit.

I also prepared the private offer draft in the AWS format and set SKU id to bundle-premium-v1. Monica, please confirm seller/reseller IDs so I can submit the private offer and include ResellCo as the designated partner in the fulfillment instructions.

Karthik Iyer
Principal, Marketplace Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Johnson <k.johnson@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, ResellCo Partner <partnersales@resellco.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Proposed private offer terms for Acme — please review

Kyle —

Thanks for your patience. Attached are the formal artifacts: draft private offer PDF and the pricing spreadsheet with both commission scenarios. TL;DR of recommended commercials to take to procurement:
- SKU: bundle-premium-v1 (single AWS private offer SKU)
- Customer price: 25% off marketplace list, 12-month term, $600k minimum commit (annualized).
- Commission: apply ResellCo commission to discounted customer price (Scenario B) — ResellCo ~25% of customer price, Redwood net ~60% after marketplace pool and taxes.
- Onboarding credit: one-time $12k credit to ResellCo upon joint go-live and co-marketing deliverables.
- Operational: Acme to nominate which billing entity signs the PO in AWS; if Acme requires MSA redline we can parallel track and still issue private offer conditionally.

Next steps: please confirm (1) acceptance of the Scenario B economics, (2) billing signer (Acme or ResellCo), and (3) if you want the DocuSign MSA for parallel review (link included). If all green, Karthik will submit the private offer to AWS Marketplace and Monica will onboard ResellCo.

DocuSign (optional MSA): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef123456
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/ACME-RI-2026-Q1

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
